messages:
Alex: planning a small engine + quant push to prod slot-a-3 tonight 23:00 UTC. who will claim rollout & own the smoke checks? need rollback readiness and an on-call to monitor. target 30m watch window after deploy. @Mira?
Mira: I can take the slot owner role. will run the smoke checklist and coordinate rollback if needed. please confirm quant profile and kernel version.
Alex: thanks. quant profile = q8_fast_v2, kernel = 0.9.4. canary in staging looked fine (no perf regressions). expected p95 baseline ~120ms, aim <150ms. keep fallback model pinned v1-fallback for 24h.
Sam: I can own rollback execution and tracing monitoring. I’ll be on pager for the window. add me to the incident channel for notifications.
Mira: adding quick smoke checklist here so we have a single place:
```
# smoke checklist (run after slot flip)
curl -sS https://slot-a-3.internal/health | jq .status
# sample generation (small prompt)
python tools/sample_check.py --host slot-a-3.internal --prompt "Hello" --n 3
# kv cache warm (check miss rate)
curl -sS https://slot-a-3.internal/metrics | grep kv_cache_miss
# perf sample 50x: run ab or wrk to capture p95
wrk -t2 -c10 -d30s http://slot-a-3.internal/sample_gen
```
Mira: I’ll post pass/fail and the perf snapshot here. if any check fails -> immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @Alex for 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC to slot-a-3. CI: all green. ETA window 45m. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
Jordan: small note — if we see >5% error increase or p95 >200ms, cut it and rollback. also ensure fallback routing is active for 1h post-deploy.
Alex: agreed. rollback steps (short):
1) run scripts/rollback_slot.sh --slot slot-a-3
2) pin v1-fallback to traffic by toggling routing flag in console
3) notify infra & reopen canary if needed
Sam: I have the rollback script ready and SSH access. will trigger and post trace links. I’ll also take the first 15m of active monitoring after Mira declares pass.
Mira: thanks — I’ll claim the deployment ownership at T-15 and start smoke at T+5 after flip. posting reminders to #eng-oncall too. :thumbsup:
Alex: plan looks good. quick ask: @Mira can you drop the exact CLI commands you’ll run for the flip so Sam can rehearse?
Mira: sure, final flip commands I’ll use:
```
# flip traffic to new engine
./deploy/flip_traffic --target slot-a-3 --model q8_fast_v2 --kernel 0.9.4 --sticky-fallback v1-fallback
# verify rollout status
./deploy/status --slot slot-a-3 --format short
```
Sam: rehearsed the rollback path locally. will be ready at 23:00 UTC. I’ll also open a tracing window and pin alerts for error rate.
Mira: posting final ETA: flip scheduled 23:00 UTC, smoke run 23:05-23:15, 15m watch -> close by ~23:30-23:45. will update with PASS/FAIL here.
Alex: awesome. thanks team. keep this thread for updates only. if we have to escalate, ping #incidents.
Mira: PASS (23:10 UTC) — health ok, sample gen good, p95 138ms, no KV anomalies. watching 15m.
Sam: observed stable traces, error rate steady. leaving monitoring for remainder of watch.
Mira: WATCH COMPLETE (23:27 UTC) — no regressions, leaving fallback pinned for 24h as planned. closing rollout. :party_popper:
